What Abundant sells

  • Custom RL environments and datasets: Simulation and model-training work for coding and physical science. Also covers recursive self-improvement (models working to improve their own capabilities) and alignment (guiding models toward intended and safe behavior).
  • SWE-gen: Turns code changes into verified coding tasks. Rebuilds a buggy starting point from working code to reduce errors caused by broken tests.
  • SWE-Marathon: Tests extended software work, including rebuilding libraries and complete applications. Also covers machine-learning engineering.
  • TheoremSmith: Creates difficult proof tasks in Lean (software that checks whether mathematical proofs are correct). Uses isolated checks to detect attempts to game rewards.
